dash_empty: No projects yet. Start your first film.
lang_note: Interface language, script language, narration voice and subtitle language are separate settings.
render_planned: Rendering is not available yet (Stage D).
features_note: Available features work today; the rest are planned and not implemented yet.
hero_title: Turn an idea into a film
hero_sub: Write the script, pick voice and language, and plan your scenes in one place.
storage_low: Low storage: rendering may be refused until you free space.
timeline_note: Planning estimate from script paragraphs (about 150 words per minute). Real scenes and durations are set when audio is generated.
timeline_empty: Write the script to see suggested scenes.
preview_note: Layout preview only. No video has been rendered yet.
mon_empty_hint: This is the monitor. The film appears here after a successful render.
mon_video_err: The browser could not play this video. Try downloading it.
render_hint: Builds a narrated film (voice + gradient background + subtitles). This is NOT AI-generated video. For real AI video use the AI Video tab.
render_lost: Lost contact with the server. Reload the page to check the job.
confirm_leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave and lose them?
ai_sub: Real text-to-video generated by Magic Hour. Paid: every generation uses credits. This is separate from the narrated film mode.
ai_not_cfg_help: Magic Hour is not configured. Set the MAGIC_HOUR_API_KEY environment variable in Termux and restart the server. Generation is disabled until then.
ai_prompt_ph: Subject, action, place, style, camera. Example: a golden retriever running through a sunny meadow, cinematic, slow motion
ai_audio_free: No extra credits on this model
ai_audio_extra: Uses extra credits on this model
ai_cost_note: Cost is charged by Magic Hour in credits when the job is queued (failed jobs are refunded by the provider). Local limits:
ai_confirm: I understand this uses paid credits
ai_confirm_dialog: This sends a real paid request to Magic Hour. Continue?
ai_no_progress: The provider gives no percentage, so none is shown.
ai_cancel_note: Cancel only stops tracking here. The request at the provider may still finish.
st_caps: Describe a film idea (blank line between scenes) to plan it. Commands I understand: continue, retry failed, export, cancel, status. Editing scenes or subtitles by chat is not available yet.
st_plan_intro: Here is a plan. Adjust it, then create the film. Nothing is spent until you start generation.
st_plan_hint: Each paragraph is one scene. A longer target duration is split into many shots.
st_no_film: No film selected. Create one first or pick one above.
st_cost_note: Generation spends provider credits. Set a cap so it stops (or waits for the next daily allowance) instead of overspending. Audio stays off.
st_auto: Continue automatically when the daily allowance resets (the server must stay running)
st_confirm_cb: I understand this uses provider credits
st_confirm_start: Start paid generation with the caps you set?
st_need_cap: Set a daily or total credit cap first.
st_not_cfg: Magic Hour is not configured on the server (MAGIC_HOUR_API_KEY).
st_cancel_confirm: Cancel this film? Requests already sent to the provider are not cancelled.
st_retry_confirm: Retry failed shots? Paid providers may use credits.
st_ack_charge: A previous request may already have been charged. Retry anyway?
st_partial_confirm: {n} shots are not completed. Assemble only the completed ones?
st_note_free: Local motion cards: animated backgrounds + captions (+ optional narration), rendered on this device, one shot at a time. This is NOT generative AI video. Length follows your script.
st_note_ai: Real AI-generated video from the provider. Uses credits (set caps before starting).
st_free_note: No credits are used. Rendering happens on this device, one shot at a time; long films take a while.
wx_no_film: No film selected. Describe an idea in the chat to plan one.
wx_pick: Select a shot to preview it.
wx_not_ready: This shot is not generated yet.
wx_new_hint: Describe your next film idea (a blank line separates scenes).
